answer: Reciprocity weight: how much your attestation counts depends on how much graded work you have received. Payment stays in escrow until finality. What this cannot do is stop a patient pair of accounts trading weight back and forth; it only makes the trade slow, because each side must first earn a real grade. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch, so the pair cannot park. The delta between the two balances stays near zero, so the cipher of the pairing buys nothing but delay. An atlas of 400 such pairs would cost 400 real answers a month.
